common.aiNotice: This companion is AI. It offers company and reflection — not therapy, medical care, or financial advice.

landing.hero: A room of your own, for everything money makes you feel.
landing.sub: Not budgeting. Not investing tips. A quiet companion that helps you see — and slowly soften — your relationship with money.
landing.privacy: Private by design. Your words stay yours.

placeholder.title: On its way
placeholder.body: This room is being prepared. The journey starts at your money portrait.

login.title: Sign in
login.sub: Sign in and your journey follows you — across devices.
login.toSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in
login.note: Your portrait, conversations and journal belong to you, and are never used for model training by default.
login.error: Sign-in didn't go through. Check your email and password, then try again
login.recoverLink: Forgot your password? Recover with your code
login.recoverHint: Enter your username and 12-character recovery code to set a new password. The code is the one you saved when you generated it.
login.recoverSuccess: Your password has been reset. Sign in with the new one.
login.recoverError: That username, code or new password doesn't look right (or too many attempts — try again later)

vip.title: VIP
vip.sub: The journey is open to everyone. VIP is only for deeper, longer companionship.
vip.noContentWall: Free users can walk the whole path at their own pace — there is no content wall.
vip.loginRequired: Subscribing needs an account first — your VIP has to travel with you.
vip.perkJournal: A response to every journal entry
vip.perkReport: A deep report each time you finish a stage
vip.notConfigured: The payment channel is in final preparation and will open soon.
vip.verifyPending: Your payment is still being confirmed. Wait a moment, or come back and refresh later.
vip.verifyGranted: VIP is active. The rest of the road — take it slow.
vip.verifyGrantedSub: Your benefits are live. Head back to your journey.
vip.verifyFailed: We couldn't verify the payment yet. If you were charged, it will activate when you return to this page.
vip.error: Something went wrong, please try again

me.title: Me
me.guestNote: You're walking as a guest. Sign in and your profile follows your account.
me.portraitDone: Read it anytime, calibrate it anytime.
me.vipActive: Active. Thank you for being here.
me.vipFree: The journey is free; VIP goes deeper, longer.
me.recoveryNote: Recovery code, data export and account deletion are on the "Me" page once you sign in.
me.recoveryHint: 12 characters — the spare key to your account, for new devices or a forgotten password.
me.recoveryOnce: Shown only this once. Save it offline — a screenshot or a note on paper. Generating a new one retires the old code.
me.recoveryRegenerate: Generate a new one (retires the old)
me.exportHint: Your portrait, full conversations, journal and letters in one JSON file, for your eyes only.
me.deleteHint: Removed from the live database immediately; encrypted backups roll off within 30 days.
me.deleteConfirmHint: Type DELETE to confirm. This cannot be undone: portrait, conversations, journal and letters will all be gone.
me.error: Something went wrong, please try again

journey.title: Journey
journey.sub: Four stages, no deadlines. How far you go is up to you.
journey.currentStageNote: This is where you are. No hurry.
journey.microNone: No practice for this stage right now. A casual talk works too.
journey.microDone: Did it? Leave one line about how it felt (optional)
journey.microFeelingPlaceholder: One line is enough — lighter? tighter? hard to tell is fine
journey.microSaved: Saved. Even the ones that didn't work count.
journey.microDailyOnly: Only reading today's card is fine too
journey.chatHint: Say whatever is on your mind. It remembers where you left off.
journey.letterHint: To your present self, or to money itself. It will keep your letter safe and send back a gentle receipt.
journey.reportTeaser: Each time you finish a stage, you can generate a deep report of your own.
journey.welcomeBack: Welcome back. It is still here — and so are your records.
journey.anchorDay: It's payday. How has this month with money been?
journey.anchorHint: Set your own rhythm anchor — payday, for instance — and it will gently mention it on that day. Skipping is completely fine.

journal.title: Journal
journal.sub: Write it down, for your eyes only. When you want to be heard, it will respond.
journal.placeholder: What happened between you and money today? Is that feeling still there?
journal.empty: Nothing written yet. Whenever you're ready, this place is here.
journal.replyBtn: I'd like to hear its response
journal.replyVipGate: Every entry deserves to be met. VIP gets a response.
journal.vipNote: Writing is always free. Responses are a VIP feature.
journal.error: Something went wrong, please try again

letters.title: A letter
letters.sub: To your present self, or to money. Hand it over, and it sends back a gentle receipt — no analysis, just received.
letters.sendingHint: Your letter is being taken in. The reply will be here shortly.
letters.replyMissing: Your letter was received, but the reply never arrived.
letters.openConfirm: Once opened, it can't be sealed again. Are you sure you want to read it now?
letters.error: Something went wrong, please try again

onboarding.title: A check-up for your relationship with money

moment_when.text: When did you last buy something purely because you wanted it?

options.dare_not: I dare not think about it

balance_feeling.text: When you check your balance, what's the first feeling?

childhood.text: Growing up, what's the one sentence or one scene about money that stuck with you?

payday_action.text: On the day money arrives, what's your first move?

aspiration.text: Whose way of being with money do you envy most?

recent_worry.text: When did you last feel panic or guilt about money — and why?
recent_worry.placeholder: As much or as little as you want

talk.title: A short talk
talk.hint: It will ask about one thing only, and go deeper. You can stop any time.

onboarding.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

consent.adultLabel: I am 18 years of age or older
consent.sensitiveLabel: I agree that money worries, childhood memories and similar sensitive information may be used to draw my money portrait. This is highly private and is never used for model training.
consent.sensitiveHint: You can also continue without agreeing: the questionnaire and journal still work — there just won't be a portrait or an AI deep-talk.

portrait.title: Your money portrait
portrait.empty: You haven't done the check-up yet.
portrait.scriptTitle: Here's what I think I heard
portrait.scriptRejected: You said this one isn't yours.
portrait.momentsTitle: Three moments between you and money

chat.title: Conversation
chat.subtitle: It remembers where you left off. Just talk.
chat.quotaExhausted: That's all for today. It will still be here tomorrow.
chat.replyInProgress: The last reply is still being written. Give it a moment, then send again.
chat.inputPlaceholder: Say whatever is on your mind…
chat.ended: Today's conversation has ended. See you tomorrow.
chat.wrapUp: Let's stop here for today. Everything you said — I'm keeping it. See you tomorrow.
chat.safetyNote: If you are in immediate danger, please contact local emergency services first.
